args.query: SELECT cohort, COUNT(participant_id) AS enrollment_count FROM participants WHERE consent_status = 'enrolled' GROUP BY cohort;

INSERT INTO results_summary (analysis_id, metric, condition, value, n, computed_at, author) SELECT NULL, 'Current Enrollment', cohort, COUNT(participant_id), COUNT(participant_id), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'system' FROM participants WHERE consent_status = 'enrolled' GROUP BY cohort;
